_comment: Source of truth for the caption text drawn onto the Store screenshots.
make-store-screenshots.ps1 is a renderer - edit THIS file, never the PNGs
(canon invariant 16: a render target is regenerated, not hand-edited).
Keys are the ISO 639-1 codes of the 13 UI languages (see
'store' is the Partner Center locale the rendered file is uploaded to;
'font' must cover the script - Segoe UI has no Devanagari/Bengali/Han;
'rtl' turns on DirectionRightToLeft when the strings are drawn.
EN/RU/UK are proofread by the author. The other ten are machine
translations and are NOT proofread - same honesty note as the app and
